notes: Rule 11, narrated encounter: Ibn Umar asks («فسألت ماذا قال») and «قالوا» (people, unnamed) answer with the saying. They are not written as a link; whether they are a source or only in the scene is for the ruling.
«قرأت على مالك» is a reading formula; «قال ابن عمر فأقبلت» is Ibn Umar's own narration.
